newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Q1-Q3 freight volume slightly down yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Q1-Q3 freight volume slightly down yr/yr.

text.p: The volume of Hungary's domestic freight transport, a measure of the country's economic activity, dropped in the first three quarters of 1996 compared to the same period last year, the Central Statistical Office (CSO) said in a statement on Tuesday.

"The weight of total deliveries in the first three quearters of the year was 11.6-percent less than in the corresponding period of 1995, while the performance measured in tonne-kilometres was 0.4-percent down," it said.

Rail accounted for some 30.2 percent and road for some 41.9 percent, or 17.61 billion tonne-kilometres, of freight transportation in the January-September period of 1996, the CSO said. Total freight weight was 116.17 million tonnes in that period.
